waters.note: USGS National Hydrography Dataset, high resolution (The National Map NHD MapServer, layer 6 'Flowline - Large Scale'): 1 flowlines by permanent identifier ({6F24A13E-CCB5-4831-83A5-BB36901876F1}) in CT, cut to the state, merged and simplified to ~10 m (reach codes 02030203001857). Hand record: EPA's CSO inventory gives Johnson's Creek as the receiving water of Bridgeport East Side outfall 006 (CT0101010, Bay Street and Mildner Drive, 41.17302 N 73.16142 W) and the DEEP dashboard names it for 32 reports of the Bridgeport East Side WPCA. USGS GNIS lists the stream as Johnsons Creek (feature 208183), 1.4 km from its source at 41.17751 N 73.15611 W to its mouth at 41.16622 N 73.16400 W; neither NHDPlus V2.1 nor the NHD high-resolution flowlines carry that name (the nearest named water, Bruce Brook, ends 240 m from the outfall), and OpenStreetMap has no waterway of that name. This record is the NHD high-resolution artificial-path flowline (permanent identifier above) that lies along the GNIS source-to-mouth line (78% of its length within 150 m of that line, the GNIS mouth 27 m from it, the outfall 77 m from it); the geometry is approximate, and the reports, which give no point, are placed by name.
